stem.t: Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT?

options: The intersection of two regular languages is regular.
The intersection of two context-free languages is context-free.
The intersection of two recursive languages is recursive.
The intersection of two recursively enumerable languages is recursively enumerable.

stem.t:
Consider the following statements.

Which of the above statements is/are TRUE?
If L is a regular language over Σ = {a,b}, which one of the following languages is NOT regular?

options: Suffix (L) = {y ε Σ* such that xy ε L}
Prefix (L) = {x ε Σ*| ∃y ε Σ* such that xy ε L}
L.L^{R}= {xy | x ε L, y^{R}ε L}
